 UAE Bulls vs Royal Desert Champions Preview & Prediction | 2026 Abu Dhabi T10 | League Stage
 by Alex Sarwar · 16 November 2026 at 7:30 pm 
 Updated 16 November 2026 at 9:12 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 UAE Bulls are verging on must-win territory here as they face Royal Desert Champions, who are already all-but eliminated. 
 Date & time:
 17 November 2026 at 4:00 pm 
 Venue: Sheikh Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi, UAE
 Weather:  Lots of sunshine with temperatures of around 27-28c.
 How to watch:  UK – ARY Plus & ARY Digital / USA – FloLive
 How to get tickets: Click here for the latest ticket information for UAE Bulls vs Royal Desert Champions 
 UAE Bulls vs Royal Desert Champions prediction 
 UAE Bulls have not had the league stage campaign they would've wanted but there is still time for them to rescue things if they can finish strongly. That starts by beating a poor Royal Desert Champions side, who have lost six of their eight games so far.
 With a terrible net-run-rate, the Desert Champions' hopes of reaching the playoffs are all but over, which could well have a negative effect mentally on their players, who may begin to check out as we reach the final stretch of league stage fixtures. Therefore, consider backing the Bulls in this one.
 UAE Bulls vs Royal Desert Champions tip:  UAE Bulls to win
